figures.benchmark-main: Frozen r5. Main endpoint: 36 non-Clifford tasks; gate strata n=12 each. Controls n=12. Exact probabilities, independent Qiskit reference, absolute tolerance 5e-5. Native QPU is the fixed added-layer simulator. The primary group overlaps its three gate strata.
figures.benchmark-paired: Paired end-to-end outcomes, including format, time and budget failures. No core-only substitution. Wilson intervals describe the predefined task sample.
figures.benchmark-errors: Two event probabilities per task; maximum absolute error shown. Faithfulness is separately required even when numerical outputs happen to match.
figures.benchmark-cost: Wall time includes decoding, native execution and progress I/O. Points include every condition; success and failure markers are distinct. Prediction count is not a hardware speed comparison.
